dedupe_keys.name: eshm20 2020 european seismic hazard model efehr

description: ESHM20 is the 2020 European Seismic Hazard Model, a probabilistic model of earthquake ground shaking across Europe, published by the European Facilities for Earthquake Hazard and Risk (EFEHR), which forms part of the EPOS thematic core service for seismology. It has been available since December 2021 through the hazard.EFEHR portal and the EFEHR GitLab. The main datasets (Danciu and others, 2021, DOI 10.12686/eshm20-main-datasets) include hazard maps, curves and model components as shapefiles and tables, and the complete model input for the OpenQuake engine is released separately (DOI 10.12686/eshm20-oq-input). The data are available free under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: results are probabilistic values for given return periods, and the model is not itself a legal design code. It is the continental hazard input for seismic exposure and fragility analyses of European infrastructure networks and can be rerun with OpenQuake; a related record is the GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map, and the engine is catalogued as the OpenQuake Engine.
